tool_schemas.name: create_or_update_file
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a single file at `file_path` on `branch` in the specified project and returns the newly created commit snapshot for that change. If `last_commit_id` is provided, the branch head must match it or the request is rejected with CONFLICT to prevent overwriting concurrent updates. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs/branch/path or missing required fields, NOT_FOUND if the project, author user, or branch does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the author is not permitted to commit to the project/branch.

project_id.description: ULID of the project to modify (projects.id).

file_path.description: Repository-relative file path to create or update.

content.description: New file contents as a UTF-8 string.

last_commit_id.description: Optional expected current head commit id for the branch to prevent overwriting concurrent changes (commits.id).

tool_schemas.name: search_repositories
tool_schemas.description: Searches projects by free-text `query` over name/path/description and returns a paged list of matching repositories sorted by `sort`/`order`. Pagination is controlled by `page` (1-based) and `page_size` (max 100) and the response returns only that slice of results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter/sort/pagination values and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to list projects matching the requested visibility/namespace/owner constraints.

query.description: Free-text search query applied to project name/path/description.

tool_schemas.name: create_repository
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new project under `namespace` owned by `owner_user_id` and returns the created repository including its configured `default_branch` and visibility. The `path` must be a unique slug within the namespace; attempting to reuse an existing namespace/path raises CONFLICT. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs or required fields, NOT_FOUND if the owner user does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the owner is not allowed to create projects in the specified namespace.

owner_user_id.description: ULID of the user who will own the project (users.id).

namespace.description: Namespace/group path the project belongs to.

tool_schemas.name: get_file_contents
tool_schemas.description: Reads repository content at `path` from the given `ref` (branch name or commit id) and returns either file contents for a file path or a directory listing for a directory path. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist, the ref cannot be resolved, or the path does not exist at that ref. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs or empty ref/path and FORBIDDEN if the caller does not have access to read the project at its visibility level.

project_id.description: ULID of the project to read from (projects.id).

ref.description: Git ref to read from (branch name or commit sha/id).

path.description: Repository-relative path to a file or directory.

tool_schemas.name: push_files
tool_schemas.description: Creates a single commit on `branch` that creates or updates every entry in `files`, and returns the resulting commit snapshot for the batch change. If `last_commit_id` is provided, the branch head must match it or the request fails with CONFLICT to prevent racing updates. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, an empty `files` list, or invalid file entries, NOT_FOUND if the project, author user, or branch does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the author is not permitted to commit to the project/branch.

project_id.description: ULID of the project to modify (projects.id).

commit_message.description: Commit message for the batch change.

file_path.description: Repository-relative file path to create or update.

content.description: New file contents as a UTF-8 string.

files.description: List of file updates to include in the commit.

last_commit_id.description: Optional expected current head commit id for the branch to prevent overwriting concurrent changes (commits.id).

tool_schemas.name: create_issue
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new issue in the specified project and returns the created issue, including its initial `state` (defaulting to opened when omitted). Raises NOT_FOUND if the project, author user, or assignee user (when provided) does not exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields and FORBIDDEN if the author is not permitted to create issues in the project.

project_id.description: ULID of the project to create the issue in (projects.id).

author_user_id.description: ULID of the user creating the issue (users.id).

assignee_user_id.description: ULID of the user assigned to the issue (users.id).

tool_schemas.name: create_merge_request
tool_schemas.description: Creates a merge request from `source_branch` in `source_project_id` into `target_branch` in `target_project_id` and returns the created merge request. Raises NOT_FOUND if either project does not exist, if either branch does not exist in its respective project, or if the author user does not exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields and FORBIDDEN if the author cannot read the source/target projects or is not allowed to open merge requests against the target project.

source_project_id.description: ULID of the source project containing the changes (projects.id).

target_project_id.description: ULID of the target project to merge into (projects.id).

author_user_id.description: ULID of the user creating the merge request (users.id).

source_branch.description: Source branch name in the source project.

target_branch.description: Target branch name in the target project.

tool_schemas.name: fork_repository
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new project as a fork of `project_id` owned by `owner_user_id` (optionally under `namespace`) and returns the forked repository. If the destination namespace/path already exists, the fork is rejected with CONFLICT. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs/fields, NOT_FOUND if the source project or owner user does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the owner cannot fork the source project or create projects in the destination namespace.

project_id.description: ULID of the project to fork (projects.id).

owner_user_id.description: ULID of the user who will own the forked project (users.id).

namespace.description: Namespace/group path to place the fork under (defaults to the owner's namespace if omitted).

name.description: Name for the forked project (defaults to the source project's name if omitted).

path.description: URL/path-safe repository path (slug) for the fork (defaults to the source project's path if omitted).

visibility.description: Visibility for the fork (defaults to source visibility if omitted).

tool_schemas.name: create_branch
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new branch `name` in the specified project starting from `ref` and returns the created branch reference pointing at the resolved commit. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or `ref` cannot be resolved to an existing branch/commit in that project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for empty/invalid branch names or refs, CONFLICT if a branch with the same name already exists, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to create branches in the project.

project_id.description: ID of the project to create the branch in (gl_prj_... ULID).

name.description: Name of the new branch (e.g., feature/my-change).

ref.description: Existing branch name, commit ID (gl_cmt_... ULID), or git SHA to base the new branch on.

protected.description: Whether the new branch should be marked as protected.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_user
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota counters. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the supplied credentials are missing/invalid.

access_token.description: Bearer access token used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: get_repository
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single repository (project) by `project_id`. By default excludes soft-deleted projects; set `include_deleted=true` only to retrieve a deleted record when permitted. Refuses with FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the project and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist (or is deleted and not included).

access_token.description: Bearer access token used to authenticate the request.

project_id.description: ULID of the project to fetch (projects.id).

include_deleted.description: Whether to allow returning a project with status='deleted' when the caller is allowed to see it.

tool_schemas.name: update_merge_request_state
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a merge request between lifecycle states by applying an allowed `state_event`. For `merge`, the merge request must be in state='opened' and merge_status must indicate it can be merged; otherwise the request is rejected with CONFLICT. Refuses with FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot update the merge request, and NOT_FOUND if the merge request does not exist (or is soft-deleted).

access_token.description: Bearer access token used to authenticate the request.

merge_request_id.description: ULID of the merge request to update (merge_requests.id).

state_event.description: Requested state transition event: close (opened→closed), reopen (closed→opened), merge (opened→merged).

merged_by_user_id.description: User performing the merge (required when state_event='merge').

merge_commit_message.description: Optional commit message to use for the merge commit when merging.

metadata.name: GitLab
metadata.description: This backend models a GitLab-like code hosting service focused on projects (repositories), their git references (branches), versioned files, and collaboration artifacts (issues and merge requests). The main workflows are creating/searching projects, forking, creating branches, reading file contents,
